headline: Approved minutes from two earlier appeal hearings; no motor vehicle appeals were filed.
summary: No taxpayers came forward to file motor vehicle appeals, so no hearings or deliberations were held. The meeting approved minutes from an earlier motor vehicle appeal hearing and from real property appeal hearings.
decisions: Approved minutes of the September 22, 2025 motor vehicle appeal hearings, all in favor.
Approved minutes of the April 22 and April 29, 2026 real property assessment appeal hearings, all in favor.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Board of Assessment Appeals 
Minutes         
         
Special Meeting 
 
6:00 PM, September 23, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER/ATTENDANCE   
 Chair Jim Pascarella called the meeting to order at 6:18pm.  Present and voting were Ross 
Prinz and Chair Pascarella. 
2. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 On one came forward to make public comment. 
3. SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA   
 
 
  1. Approval of Previous Motor Vehicle Appeal Hearing Minutes - September 22, 2025  
   
Chair Pascarella called for a motion to approve the Minutes from the September 22, 
2025 Motor Vehicle Appeal Hearings.  Motion was made by member Prinz and 
seconded by Chair Pascarella. 
Vote: All in favor. 
  2. Approval of Previous Real Property Assessment Appeal Hearing Minutes - April 22, 
2026 and April 29, 2026  
   
Member Prinz moved to approve the Real Property Assessment Appeal Minutes from 
April 22 and 29, 2026.  Chair Pascarella seconded. 
Vote:  All in favor 
  3. Conduct Motor Vehicle Assessment Appeals 
The hearings regarding appeals of motor vehicle assessments will be held in the 
parking lot of Government Center. Applications are available on the Assessor’s 
webpages under “Forms” or will be provided at the time of the meeting. It is 
recommended to bring completed applications with supporting documents to the 
hearing. Applicants will meet with the Board on a first come, first served basis.  
   
Board Members Prinz and Pascarella confirmed that no taxpayers were present to file 
Motor Vehicle appeals. The Board then closed the Motor Vehicle Appeal Hearings. 
  4. Motor Vehicle Appeal Deliberations
As no taxpayers came forward to file Motor Vehicle appeals, no deliberations were 
held. 
4. ADJOURNMENT   
  
Motion to adjourn was made by Board member Prinz and seconded by Chair 
Pascarella.  All were in favor and the meeting was adjourned at 6:31pm.
